name: Rimband
description: The ring runs right to the edge of the cell, so it meets its neighbours.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 100%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 100%, transparent 100%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
